requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, reference-based original production game asset.
The attached Rally Pals approved gameplay concept is the STYLE REFERENCE. Derive ONLY a new far-distance meadow landscape layer in exactly its lush painterly toy-console material language.
Create ONE wide panoramic cutout on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. No sky rectangle and no court. A distant turquoise lake with rocky banks and layered soft green hills, hazy blue mountains, a cozy tiny cream-and-timber meadow village and windmill on the far ridge. Leafy background groves and colorful flower spots along the far bank. Warm late-morning sunshine, soft crafted surface texture, rounded organic detail, coherent perspective viewed from behind a tennis player across a flat meadow court. The landscape should span the entire width, with a natural irregular skyline and a shallow grounded lower bank; leave transparent sky above. Its tallest distant landmarks occupy the upper-middle third. Wide 2:1 panorama composition, clean isolation with true alpha outside landscape. This is a parallax layer that will stand behind real 3D court geometry, not a gameplay screenshot.
Keep the reference's rich grass, moss, stone, wood and miniature-village workmanship. Original design; no borrowed branded assets.
Absolutely NO UI, lettering, numbers, logos, signs with writing, tennis court, net, ball, rackets, foreground player, target words, actors, black outlines, flat low-poly triangles, blank geometric hills, watermark or cast shadow outside the cutout. Every object is environment only. Do not include any part of the reference HUD.

Use case: stylized-concept. Derive original production SCENERY CUTOUT ATLAS from the attached Rally Pals concept's rich painterly miniature-toy-console materials.
One true transparent alpha image, strict 2 columns by 2 rows of FOUR independently isolated complete assets, each centered within its own equal rectangle, 10% transparent gutter and no touching between cells. Never draw cell borders, labels, words or any UI. Same daylight from upper left as reference, soft rounded modeled forms with detailed painterly wood, leaves, grass, stone and plush cloth.
TOP LEFT: one beautiful full round-canopy leafy meadow tree, warm crooked trunk, dense irregular clusters of individual green leaves and tiny natural moss at foot; entire tree visible.
TOP RIGHT: cozy compact tennis clubhouse made of sculpted timber and cream plaster, gray-brown shingled roof, two windows, little porch and green/golden pennants; whole building visible, no lettering or emblems.
BOTTOM LEFT: one long low raised wooden planter densely filled with daisies, tiny blue/purple flowers, yellow and peach blossoms, varied lush green leaves; full planter including weathered plank sides and feet.
BOTTOM RIGHT: one full low wooden spectator stand with two rows of SMALL adorable ORIGINAL plush animal spectators: teddy bears, rabbits, little foxes, raccoons. Soft tactile toy materials and joyful faces, varied gentle colors, no branded characters, no lettering, no rackets, no court. Complete stand including supports.
Match approved screenshot craft, detail and warm color, not flat icon art or faceted low-poly primitives. These assets will sit at separate world positions surrounding a real 3D tennis court. True transparent pixels around EVERY asset, no floor rectangle, no sky, no baked large ground shadow, no blurry backdrop, no chessboard pattern, no HUD or text. Wide landscape atlas composition, four equally sized cells.

Use case: stylized-concept. The attached approved Rally Pals gameplay image is a STYLE reference only. A few tiny timber/thatch prehistoric club huts among the far groves, no modern village or windmill. Warm early afternoon sunshine and soft organic modeled materials, vivid but gentle, detailed leaves and textured natural rock. Coherent behind-player tennis-club perspective across flat ground, panorama spans full width, natural irregular skyline with transparent sky above. Shallow irregular grassy lower bank, distant cliffs/huts kept in middle half with foreground empty. Wide 2:1 landscape parallax layer, not a screenshot, no full tennis court. Absolutely no UI, letters, numbers, writing, logos, watermarks, glyphs, net, balls, rackets, player, modern houses, moon, faceted triangles, flat primitive hills or opaque rectangular sky/ground backdrop. All pixels outside environmental silhouette must have true alpha, not checkerboard.
